DECIDED #1500: intentional test seam, and newly test-ONLY as of step 1. Before step 1 this property WAS the production owner-window lookup (GetMainWindow() => MainWindowResolver()); the lookup now lives on AvaloniaWindowHost, whose own MainWindowResolver IS production-reachable via MainWindow => MainWindowResolver(). What remains here is a forwarding shim kept so the 17 existing test call sites that assign vm.MainWindowResolver keep steering the real adapter without any test change. Routing GetMainWindow() back through this property to satisfy the gate was considered and rejected: it would make only the getter reachable (the setter is assigned by tests alone regardless) and would reshape production code for a tool. Retires with the other host seams at the design's step 12 (docs/architecture/main-window-architecture.md).
